question: top POI categories Lisbon count >500
sql: SELECT basic_category, COUNT(*) AS place_count FROM lisbon_places GROUP BY basic_category HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY place_count DESC

question: Lisbon POI confidence buckets low medium high counts
sql: WITH buckets AS (SELECT CASE WHEN confidence >= 0.8 THEN 'high' WHEN confidence >= 0.5 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END AS conf_bucket FROM lisbon_places) SELECT conf_bucket, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM buckets GROUP BY conf_bucket ORDER BY cnt DESC

question: Lisbon open vs closed share restaurant beauty fashion categories
sql: SELECT basic_category, operating_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY basic_category), 1) AS pct_within_category FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category IN ('restaurant', 'personal_or_beauty_service', 'fashion_and_apparel_store') GROUP BY basic_category, operating_status ORDER BY basic_category, cnt DESC

question: highest confidence POI per category Lisbon top 5 types
sql: SELECT basic_category, names.primary AS place_name, confidence, operating_status FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category IN ('restaurant', 'personal_or_beauty_service', 'fashion_and_apparel_store', 'professional_service', 'wellness_service') QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY basic_category ORDER BY confidence DESC) = 1 ORDER BY confidence DESC

question: Lisbon chain vs independent POI count by category
sql: SELECT basic_category, CASE WHEN brand.names.primary IS NOT NULL THEN 'branded_chain' ELSE 'independent' END AS brand_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM lisbon_places GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 20 ORDER BY basic_category, cnt DESC

question: Lisbon 1km grid POI density hotspots top 10 cells
sql: WITH projected AS (SELECT ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true) AS g FROM lisbon_places), cells AS (SELECT FLOOR(ST_X(g)/1000)*1000 AS x0, FLOOR(ST_Y(g)/1000)*1000 AS y0, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM projected GROUP BY x0, y0 HAVING COUNT(*) > 50) SELECT x0, y0, cnt, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Transform(ST_Point(x0+500, y0+500), 'EPSG:3763', 'EPSG:4326', always_xy := true)) AS cell_center_geojson FROM cells ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
